title: How I build your website
subtitle: I am Serhii Oberemchuk, an independent web developer. You work directly with me from the first conversation to launch.
paragraphs: We start with your audience and what visitors need to find. Together we define the pages, content and functionality.
We agree on structure, design, cost and timing. I then develop the website and share progress for review.
Before launch I check mobile layouts, forms, performance and technical SEO. After publication I hand over access and explain how to work with your website.
